title: SkillsCentral: enterprise skill governance

scenarios.title: One serving catalog, three authoring origins
scenarios.action: Inspect the three local source fixtures, then the skill catalog.
scenarios.talk_track: Author in your preferred tool; consolidate reviewed procedures into a serving catalog. These are local fixtures representing three authoring origins.
scenarios.boundary: No live GitHub repository is connected by these fixtures.

scenarios.title: Ask the agent before a policy change
scenarios.prompt: I bought an unworn jacket 38 days ago and I have the receipt. It is not final sale or personalized. Can I return it under the fictional demo policy?
scenarios.action: Use a fresh session and confirm the published baseline contains the fictional 30-day rule. Use its actual displayed version ID.
scenarios.talk_track: The agent discovers published previews, then loads the relevant procedure.
scenarios.expected: Standard eligibility is not met under the fictional 30-day window; offer specialist review.
scenarios.boundary: This is an eligibility assessment, not an executed refund or return.

scenarios.title: Publish the candidate and observe changed behavior
scenarios.action: Compare the baseline and candidate, publish the reviewed 45-day candidate using its actual version ID, then repeat the baseline prompt in a fresh session.
scenarios.talk_track: Publication changes the serving procedure without redeploying the agent.
scenarios.expected: The fictional 45-day window applies once actual serving discovery returns the candidate version.
evidence: Fresh answer from the candidate procedure
scenarios.boundary: Inspect actual serving results; do not assume search propagation is instantaneous.

scenarios.title: Withdraw a procedure while retaining history
scenarios.action: Withdraw return authorization; repeat the baseline prompt in a fresh session.
scenarios.talk_track: Retirement removes content from new serving reads and keeps its audit history.
scenarios.expected: The withdrawn return procedure is not loaded; missing approved guidance is made explicit.
evidence: No new load of the withdrawn procedure
scenarios.boundary: Other relevant published procedures may still be discovered.

scenarios.title: Restore an earlier reviewed version
scenarios.action: Publish the earlier reviewed 30-day baseline using its actual version ID, then inspect serving publication.
scenarios.talk_track: Rollback selects a prior version rather than editing history.
scenarios.expected: The baseline is again selected for serving.
evidence: Preserved candidate and earlier immutable history
scenarios.boundary: The serving version must be verified by a fresh read.

scenarios.title: Use governed context with a read-only Gateway tool
scenarios.prompt: I bought an unworn jacket 38 days ago and I have the receipt. It is not final sale or personalized. Can I return it under the fictional demo policy? Please look up order SC-1001 to verify these details before assessing eligibility.
scenarios.action: Use a fresh session. Inspect runtime Gateway discovery, the actual order-tool call, current published skill version, memory steps, and one turn trace.
scenarios.talk_track: The model discovers relevant read-only tools through the existing Context Gateway and combines timestamped fictional facts with the currently published procedure.
scenarios.expected: The turn calls skillscentral__get_order for SC-1001, preserves the fictional snapshot label, and assesses the 38-day jacket using the current publication. It never issues a return or refund.
evidence: Actual skillscentral__get_order call and fixed synthetic record
Published skill key and actual version
One trace with session/user IDs, model usage, and memory operations
scenarios.boundary: This is a real Gateway call to a fixed fictional fixture, not live retailer data. The app enforces a read-only allowlist and bounded tool loop. Memory event recording does not prove immediate long-term promotion.

scenarios.title: Track real turns and estimated model cost
scenarios.action: Inspect actual application and verification turns, zero-use catalog entries, and the Lens trace/session/user IDs.
scenarios.talk_track: This is application reporting over observed events; Lens traces the turn context.
evidence: Live-only application history; no synthetic usage seeded
Measured model-response tokens and illustrative estimation basis
scenarios.boundary: A use means a published skill was loaded into model context. Custom reporting, not a packaged Playbooks dashboard. Turn model cost is divided equally across loaded skills using illustrative configured rates; it is not billing or proof of causal cost.

scenarios.title: Serve an approved answer directly
scenarios.prompt: What are the demo customer support hours?
scenarios.action: Ask the approved FAQ in a fresh session.
scenarios.talk_track: A sufficient approved FAQ can avoid a generation call under the application policy.
scenarios.expected: Fictional support hours: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Pacific time.
scenarios.boundary: Only claim zero generation tokens if the actual turn reports no model call.

scenarios.title: Keep the fallback when guidance is missing
scenarios.prompt: Can you approve a corporate travel reimbursement?
scenarios.action: Ask a question outside the retail catalog.
scenarios.talk_track: The agent should identify missing approved guidance instead of inventing a policy.
scenarios.expected: No relevant approved retail procedure; request the appropriate source or specialist.
scenarios.boundary: Intent Router fallback is application behavior and must remain available on no match.

description: Fictional retail procedures and records, backed by real Iris service calls, Gemini responses, and live application evidence.
